summary: Resolves a resource handle from argument a2 via ResourceLookupDispatcher and stores the result in this[1] (byte offset 0x04), then writes the object through FileWriteWithBackendDispatch: the first four dword-bytes via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(this, 4) and the following two dword-bytes via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(this + 2, 2). Always returns 1. Structurally a twin of FileHandleCloseRegistration (004b4470) per cluster copy, and the legacy ABI labels it a file open/write operation.

operations.description: Store the result of ResourceLookupDispatcher(a2) into this[1] (dword at byte offset 0x04), recording the resolved resource identity.
FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(this, 4): write the first four dword-bytes of the object.
FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(this + 2, 2): write the next two dword-bytes of the object.

unresolved: Meaning of the two write lengths (4 then 2 dword-bytes) is unresolved; they likely target two adjacent record fields.
What the value stored at this+0x04 represents and how the backend dispatcher routes the write is unproven.
The cluster-copy relationship to 004b4470 is DERIVED and not independently verified.
